AUDIT: PASS
Objective Understood: Reviewed worker task 'sweep-adopt-veridian-scripts-65-feat-real-deterministic-gtm-check-script' (risk tier: tier1) by reading the actual diff, not a self-report.
Standards Reviewed: AGENTS.md Operating Rule 7c structured audit protocol; risk-tier.py's deterministic tier classification.
Scope Confirmed:  gtm_check_api_testing.py        |  91 ++++++++++++++++++++++++
 gtm_check_database_testing.py   | 149 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 gtm_check_governance_testing.py | 126 +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 gtm_write_category_result.py    | 120 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 4 files changed, 486 insertions(+)
Evidence Recorded: Four new, purely additive files (no existing file is modified, no .github/workflows/** touched, matching the tier1 classification): three real per-category GTM check scripts (API endpoint status codes over public curl, Postgres information_schema table/column existence over read-only psql, and a governance dedup/resolver check) plus a shared gtm_write_category_result.py writer that reuses superboss-register.py's established _connect()/_write_lock() convention with parameterized SQL. Credentials are read from compliance-tracker's .env.local at runtime (never hardcoded), the database check is strictly read-only, and every script fails to 'blocked' rather than fabricating a pass/fail when a precondition (credentials, non-empty queue) is missing. Two non-blocking design concerns are worth follow-up hardening (see issues) but neither is an active bug against the current, live, correctly-implemented dedup logic, so this is safe to merge as-is. Issues found: gtm_check_governance_testing.py sub-check 2 performs a live write against production (calls resource_governor.submit() colliding with a genuinely active task_identity queried fresh from umr_tasks) on every run. Under today's correct find_active_umr_by_identity() dedup logic this safely creates a new synthetic 'rejected_duplicate' row without touching the real active row's data, but if that dedup check ever regresses, submit()'s reuse-on-resubmit path (force_new_umr_id defaults False) would reuse the real active task's own umr_id and overwrite its inputs (title/prompt) with the probe's placeholder text. Recommend colliding against a dedicated synthetic/canary task_identity fixture instead of a genuinely live production task so a future dedup regression can't corrupt real in-flight work.; gtm_write_category_result.py calls sbr._connect() before entering the `with sbr._write_lock():` block, diverging from this codebase's own documented safe ordering (_write_lock()'s docstring: acquire the OS flock before opening any sqlite connection at all, specifically to prevent a repeat of the 2026-07-23 DB corruption incident). The actual UPDATE/INSERT statements are still correctly scoped inside the lock, so this isn't an active corruption bug, but the ordering should be aligned with the established convention (open the connection after acquiring the lock) for consistency and defense-in-depth.; gtm_check_governance_testing.py's sub-check 2 connects to the sqlite DB via a hardcoded DB_PATH constant rather than the resolve_superboss_db_path() value it validates in sub-check 1; harmless today since the script explicitly asserts the two paths match, but is a latent inconsistency if they ever diverge.
Severity Classified: none
Verdict: pass
Corrective Action Owner: Not required -- no issues found in this review.
Re-Audit Scheduled: Not required -- approved as-is, no follow-up needed.
